manifest.provenance: real checkpoint projections + modeled hidden states and token-sink stresses; NOT captured model activations
limitations: mixture weights are non-identifiable, not true model proportions
post-projection perturbations need not preserve DeepSeek K=V identity

local hardware/heads/shapes cannot predict 96-core online runtime

bootstrap_warning: Conditional sampling variability only; excludes model/distribution uncertainty.
absolute_score_convention: Conditional on 100 points per ratio unit per case and unweighted sum; verify if hidden scoring differs.
